login.title: Choose how to start
login.intro: Last.fm or a history file needs no login and has no user limit. Logging in with Spotify adds top artists, tracks and the player.

own.title: Use your own Spotify app
own.body: Create a free Spotify app yourself and paste its Client ID here. Each app has its own quota, so you don't depend on timuze's shared app.
own.step1: Open the Spotify Developer Dashboard, sign in and choose Create app. Any name and description work; tick Web API.
own.step2: In Redirect URI, add exactly the address below, then save.
own.step3: Open the app's Settings, copy the Client ID and paste it below.
own.step4: Under User Management, add the email of the Spotify account you'll log in with, then press the login button below.
own.clientIdFormat: A Client ID is 32 characters (0-9, a-f)
own.note1: Only the Client ID is needed – never paste the Client Secret. Login uses PKCE, so no secret is required.
own.appNameHint: The name you gave your Spotify app – shown after “timuze” while you're logged in.

lastfm.title: Last.fm
lastfm.badge: Fastest if you already use Last.fm
lastfm.body: All you need is your username – no login or password. Your scrobble history (including Apple Music or YouTube Music plays, if you've set up scrobbling) becomes stats right away.

others.filesHint: No account needed: download your personal data export from the service and drop it into timuze. Detailed steps are shown on the import screen.
